notes_for_editor: The Forest Fire Lookout Association list is the only source on the tower itself; it gives name, county, coordinates and gone status, and nothing on build date, design, staffing or fires. The refuge and map sources only show that the Agassiz name is shared. Neither links the tower to the refuge, and the story does not. The refuge timeline on the About page is ambiguous about 1961 (founding vs. name change), so only the 1937 date is used. Story is about 90 words, below the 120-word target. Two web searches found no other tower history. Consider a Marshall County historical society or Minnesota DNR records request.
